summary.en: Conan, Ran, Kogoro, and Sonoko travel to the island of Shikoku, Kagawa Prefecture, to see the kabuki play Phantom of the Konpira at the restored Konpira Grand Theatre. It is a play based on The Phantom of the Opera. Things start to mimic the play. There are requests for a heroine change, sightings of a phantom, and a deliberate attempt on the heroine, just like Phantom of the Opera. The chief of the stage setting is killed, and the chairman and the sponsor are arrested by circumstantial evidence. Attack Type: Blunt trauma by falling lantern Victim: Katsuo Nabeshima Cause of death: Stab wound Suspects: Tamanosuke Ito and Tatsuhiko Rausu Katsuo Nabeshima was stabbed in the neck from behind while waiting by a monument in the park. Victim: Tamanosuke Ito Injury: Blunt force trauma by rock Suspects: Tatsuhiko Rausu
